# NetworkSession

## Purpose
Wraps Unity Gaming Services, Multiplayer Sessions, Relay and Netcode's NetworkManager: sign in, lobby sessions, ready state, starting the host and loading the match scene.

## Concepts
lobby, session, relay, join code, ready, host, client, NetworkManager, INetworkSessionService
